title: client: e-mail + password sign-in, forced password change, change password in profile
description: Client half of epic budget-bst (tk show budget-bst). In client/src/features/auth: when GET /auth/providers says password is on, the sign-in page shows an e-mail + password form next to the existing Google / Cloudflare Access buttons; web signs in by cookie, native stores the returned token like the other native flows. A temp password leads to a 'choose a new password' step (change token flow) before the app opens. Profile gets 'Change password' for users whose /me has has_password. Depends on budget-uns: start your branch from its branch.
notes:
CONTRACT/API PROBLEM: the API sends Retry-After on 429 but CORS exposeHeaders (api/src/app.ts) is only WWW-Authenticate, so a cross-origin browser client cannot read it (verified in a real run: header present via curl, access-control-expose-headers: WWW-Authenticate). Client reads Retry-After and shows the wait when it can; on web cross-origin it falls back to 'Wait a few minutes'. Fix: add 'Retry-After' to exposeHeaders. Native is unaffected.
Built: features/auth password.logic/passwordApi/usePasswordSignIn/PasswordForms, profile ChangePasswordCard. Plain fetch (not RTK) so passwords never reach redux. tsc/eslint/bun test pass (1140). Real web run verified against local API+PG.
VALIDATION (independent): PASS with one should-fix. (1) should-fix: client/src/features/auth/signIn.logic.ts parseProviders + shared authProvidersSchema (password: z.boolean() required): an older API answering {access:true,google:false} (no password field) fails safeParse -> LEGACY_PROVIDERS (google only), so an Access-only deployment shows a Google button instead of Access during version skew (verified by running parseProviders). Fix: make password optional/default false in the client parse (e.g. parse with .extend({password: z.boolean().default(false)}) or merge), add a test. (2) minor: password-routes 403 'forbidden' on /change and sign-in e-mail cleared after dead change token fall to generic text / empty field; saveSessionToken rejection in usePasswordSignIn.finish and passwordChange is unhandled (no message, rejection escapes void submit()). (3) minor: 429 without readable Retry-After says 'a few minutes' though real wait was 52s (known CORS issue). Real web run: forced step, reload, expired/rejected change token -> sign-in form with message, expired temp, lockout message, wrong current in profile, change success (stays signed in), profile card hidden for user without password, 375px width all verified. tsc/eslint clean, bun test 1140 pass. Native untested.
Fix pass: merged tk/budget-uns 07f996b; parseProviders defaults missing password to false; token-save failures caught (usePasswordSignIn, passwordChange); 403 forbidden message; e-mail kept after dead change token; web real <form> (FormWrap.web.tsx); lockout re-run shows 'Try again in 1 minute'.
Approved by Yuri (Plannotator Inbox, 2026-11-20): merge to local main, no push. Sign-in form, forced new-password step, Change password in Profile. Validator PASS, fix pass 73bc76a (older-API providers answer, token save failures, real form on web). client 1143 tests pass; walked end to end on web in the integration run. Landed on local main as merge eb7d04f. Not verified: iOS/native.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Sign-in with e-mail + password works on web (cookie) and native (token), using the contracts from shared (contractRequest, types from the contract). 2) Errors are shown in plain words: wrong e-mail or password (one message for all invalid_credentials), too many attempts with the wait time, expired temp password (ask the admin for a new one), policy failures on a new password. 3) A temp password always goes through the new-password step; the app is not reachable until it succeeds. 4) Profile 'Change password' asks for the current and the new password and is hidden when has_password is false. 5) Password fields are secure inputs with correct autocomplete/textContentType hints (current-password / new-password, username on e-mail); passwords are never put in the store, logs or URLs. 6) Google and Access sign-in still work as before; the form is absent when providers.password is false. 7) Pure logic in *.logic.ts with tests; screenshots of the sign-in form, an error state and the new-password step (web) attached as evidence. 8) client/: tsc --noEmit, eslint ., bun test pass.
